description: This file declares the HostVirtualInput class, which is part of the confui namespace within the cuttlefish project. It defines an interface for handling user input events in a virtual host environment, including methods for event creation, user abort handling, and checking if the confirmation UI is active. It also includes references to external classes such as HostServer, HostModeCtrl, and InputConnector.

classes.name: HostVirtualInput
classes.description: A class that handles user input events in the confui namespace, integrating with HostServer, HostModeCtrl, and InputConnector to manage virtual input events.

methods.name: IsConfUiActive
methods.description: Returns true if the confirmation UI mode is active.

methods.name: CreateSink
methods.description: Creates and returns a new EventSink object for input events.
